_brief: Batch 2026-10-03 item 10, MIC ON STREET / ABRAHM ACCORDS. Tal: "You DON'T need the existing intro. Just pull out the strongest moments of individual people speaking. Each interesting answer can potentially become its own short video." + LESSONS 80 ("stop with all the zooms"): ONE constant full frame for the whole short, hard jump cuts only, no punch-in, no drift. This one: the couple from Dimona (C0521), the strongest English answer in the folder. Shape: their strongest line cold ("There's no room for hate or war...") -> where they're from ("Come visit Israel and Dimona") -> their values -> "we want everybody to be in harmony" -> Tal's "Wow" -> "It's enough room for everyone / everybody" and both of them smiling. Tal's question ("What do you want the world to know about you guys?") is cut: the answer stands alone with the sign in frame. Cut: "We love the people that love Israel" (reads as conditional), "We want to know that this is," (false start). "There's only room for prosperity": a September note heard a slip ('no room for prosperity'); four transcriptions now (Groq turbo + large-v3, whole clip and a 22-28s window) all hear 'only room' - kept, flagged in the report. Sony C0521 is portrait stored sideways (auto transpose). grade:false (as shot, his documentary look; LESSONS 72). Sound: LOCATION-SOUND.wav = the same source windows, denoised once per run, no per-beat gain (soundtrack.py).
beats: COLD OPEN, their strongest line: 'There's no room for hate or war. There's only room for prosperity, joy, and happiness.' (first word 22.55 = 0.12s in; out before 'And' 27.26)
who they are: 'Show Israel some love. Come visit Israel and Dimona.' (out before 'Shalom' 12.02)
their values: 'We're all about love, we're all about peace.' (the false start 'We want to know that this is,' cut; out before 'We love Israel, we love the people that love Israel')

PAYOFF, one unbroken take: 'And we want everybody to be in harmony with each other.' - Tal: 'Wow.' - 'It's enough room for everyone.' 'It's enough room for everybody.' - both smiling, the woman laughing; out before 'All right' 35.67. (The 0.85s breath before 'with each other' is kept: cutting it made verify-cut read the beat as ending mid-thought, and the pause is his, not dead air.)
